query: INSERT INTO photos(id,short_id,album_id,title,original_hash,original_name,original_bytes,mime,kind,status,visibility,camera_model) SELECT id,short_id,$3,'excluded',repeat('b',64),'fixture.jpg',1,'image/jpeg','image','ready',CASE WHEN n<=300 THEN 'restricted'::visibility ELSE 'public'::visibility END,CASE WHEN n<=300 THEN 'Test camera' ELSE 'other' END FROM unnest($1::uuid[],$2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS f(id,short_id,n)
